Australia Defeats South Africa in First Cricket Test

Australia secured a victory in the first Test match against South Africa in Durban, requiring six wickets on the final day to achieve the win. Josh Hazlewood was instrumental in the bowling attack. South African captain Temba Bavuma stated that his team lacked fight and was let down by their mental aptitude following the loss. Australia's win updates their standing in the WTC 2025-27 Points Table.
